newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks mixed as Bancoquia falls back.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks mixed as Bancoquia falls back.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed Wednesday in a sesssion that saw Bancoquia drop back slightly after big gains the previous day and where volume was inflated by large cross deals.
Bogota's IBB index edged up 0.58 percent to 837.86 in a 2.6 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMEd general price index drifted down 0.04 percent to 13,207.23 amid a 2.4 billion peso volume.
Bancoquia fell back 0.04 percent to 2,399 in a 523 million peso trade in Bogota and on the Medellin exchange it dropped back 2.08 percent to 2,350 in a 228 million peso trade.

The falls were preceeded by gains of almost 9.5 percent in both markets Tuesday on the back of news that Spain's banco Santander was to buy a 55 percent stake in the bank, Colombia's eighth largest in terms of assets.

Volume in Bogota was buoyed by a 798.5 million peso cross deal between exisitng shareholders in the pre-paid health care company Total Salud EPS. Medellin saw a 601 million peso cross deal in supermarket chain Cadenalco at an unchanged price of 810 pesos each. Chocolate manufacturer Nacional de Chocolates closed 0.1 percent down at 8,290 in a 917 million peso cross deal in Medellin.
